I can handle that.

To find and reschedule the right meeting, I need a bit more info:

1) Which meeting is it?
- Exact or approximate title (e.g., “Parent-Teacher Conference,” “Team Meeting with 3rd Grade Teachers”)
- Original date and start time
- Any key attendee emails if you know them

- Specific new date and time, or
- Just “move it to [day] in the [morning/afternoon]” and I’ll look for a free slot

3) Should I:
- Keep the same attendees and location?
- Notify attendees of the change (usually yes)?

Reply with whatever you know (even if approximate), and I’ll look it up and suggest or set a new time.</action>
